description: Retrieve one job listing in full by id as a single readable document: responsibilities, qualifications, benefits, compensation, locations and company context. This is the document form that pairs with `search`; `get_job_details` returns the same listing as structured fields and can append the raw employer description. An unknown id, or one whose listing has closed and been removed, returns an error. Free.

id.description: The job's id, a UUID, exactly as `search` or `search_jobs` returned it.

name: fetch
title: Fetch a job listing
